exposure: Mode of delivery in the index pregnancy (attempted ECV vs. PBC)
Management of breech presentation (attempted ECV vs. PBC)
outcome: Cesarean delivery rate in the subsequent pregnancy
cohort: 815 women who had a breech presentation in the index pregnancy
finding: Women who underwent attempted ECV for breech presentation had a significantly lower risk of cesarean delivery and composite adverse outcomes related to cesarean delivery in the subsequent pregnancy compared to women who underwent PBC.
mod_finding: Women who underwent an attempted external cephalic version for breech presentation had a five-fold decreased risk of cesarean delivery in their subsequent pregnancy compared to women who had a primary breech cesarean.
